title: expense.parsed.v1
description: Kafka topic expense.parsed.v1 (key = user_id, 3 partitions, .DLT). Published by dsService, consumed by expenseService. dsService publishes only when is_expense is true and amount > 0; the consumer drops is_expense=false. An unknown schema_version is non-retryable (straight to the DLT). Producers must not add fields (additionalProperties: false).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Anything other than 1 is non-retryable for consumers.

user_id.description: Owner of the expense (JWT sub, forwarded as X-User-Id). Also the Kafka record key.

sender.description: SMS sender id as received, e.g. HDFCBK or AX-ICICIB.

sms_received_at.description: When the SMS was received on the device (RFC 3339 date-time).

is_expense.description: The extractor's verdict. Producers only publish true; consumers drop false.

amount.description: Decimal string, never a JSON number. Producers only publish amount > 0.

account_last4.description: Last four digits of the account or card, or null when the SMS does not state them.

txn_date.description: Transaction date (calendar date), or null when unknown.
